The limber daugon spine lends a lethally taut release for arrows to fly far.
Snapstrike Spine The tight tendons connecting the spines offers a spring-like snap 
to the draw of the Arkensail Composite Bow, reducing the penalties associated 
with long-range attacks, as well as gaining a +2 bonus to Range attack rolls. 
Though this does make a resounding clatter as the bones snap that can be heard 
100 ft. away, and gives the wielder Disadvantage on Stealth checks when firing.

Developed for excavation, it quickly proved its use in cutting through more than just stone.
Tearing Spin On a Critical hit, target creature suffers an additional 1d6 Slashing 
damage at the start of their next turn from the lingering wound. 
Rending Force When making attacks with Vorexcavator, target's AC is considered 
2 lower to make the attack.
Burrowing Blades The Vorexcavator can burrow through earth or stone at a 
speed of 5 ft. per minute, creating a roughly 3-foot-wide tunnel.
Excavator If equipped while on a Foraging Expedition, you get a +2/-2 
adjustment bonus to the results.

The twinned rapier horns have an unerring aim as they quiver towards a beating heart.
Apex Quality +1 to attack rolls and hitting on a natural 18-20 will cause a Critical hit.
Vital Strike Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, target creature that got a Critical 
hit by the Heartwrought Horns. Failure: Target takes 1d6 Necrotic damage at the 
start of each of its turns for 1 minute as it begins to bleed. The creature can repeat 
the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the bleeding on a success.
Heart Seeker When submerged, the blades quiver with the direction of a beating 
heart, with a Utilization Action you may place the blades in an open body of 
water to track the largest creature within that body of water in 300 ft.. You have 
Advantage on any Wisdom checks related to tracking an undersea creature.
